maintenance_led.reason: Sells new home furnishings and cookware (Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm) as first-time consumer purchases, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers and businesses buying home furnishings through stores, e-commerce and catalogs; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by building its own brands (Pottery Barn, West Elm, Rejuvenation) and channels; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer home furnishings retail; customers can easily switch to other retailers with no retraining or disruption.
